brief: Rank the 20 highest-value tools/sites in Nicholas-AI-OS tool intelligence for next integration.
hermes_task: Analyze the Nicholas-AI-OS private tool intelligence / Web Surfers catalog that is already integrated into this project (audited scope: about 1,800 resources across about 1,501 normalized domains). Use the project context and registry knowledge available to Nicholas Operator/Hermes; do not substitute a generic internet top-20 list. Determine the 20 highest-value tools/sites we should integrate next into Nicholas-AI-OS for practical ChatGPT-driven workflows. Prioritize tools that materially improve revenue generation, business operations, research, automation, content/media production, local/fire-grant work, client coaching operations, data analysis, and cross-app execution. Prefer tools that are realistically callable/automatable, have APIs or browser-accessible workflows, are free or low-cost when possible, and do not duplicate capabilities already well-covered by ChatGPT/GitHub/Gmail/Calendar/Drive/Notion/Canva/Wix/Stripe/Finances. For each ranked item provide: rank, exact tool/site name, domain if known, primary capability, why it is valuable specifically for Nicholas-AI-OS, likely integration method (API/MCP/browser/CLI/other), cost/access tier if known, integration difficulty 1-10 (10 easiest), expected impact 1-10, and a one-line first workflow to build. Then give: (A) the top 5 to integrate first in exact order, (B) 3 tools to avoid or defer and why, (C) the single best first implementation task. Distinguish catalog-grounded facts from uncertainty and explicitly state if any part of the 1,800-resource catalog is not visible to this Hermes run. Keep the answer concise but complete, maximum 2,500 words.
